name: Hang He
source:
Hang He is one Lone River's most influential citizens. Approximately 10 percent of the city's businesses and buildings can be traced back to his name in one form or another. He is also the father [url=https://vndb.org/c167540]Hao He[/url] and apparently friends with [url=https://vndb.org/c167539]Regina[/url].
